phaseWindow.offsetConvention: compare candidate tick t with baseline tick t + lag

priorOneWriteContext.observation: 596 player/demo/frame tuples matched at phase 0; CPU, demo and input progression continued

settings.sourceBasis: Rev 0 defines player obX/obY/obVelX/obVelY at offsets $08/$0C/$10/$12; A12/A13 maps eligible object writes from $D000-$EFFF into the pre-object buffer $C000-$CFFF. Sonic_MdNormal calls Sonic_Move before SpeedToPos. Eight is a fixed small multiwrite budget intended to allow later natural object writes in the same frame to be affected; static source does not establish the dynamic next-write sequence or prove a kinematic write is reached.

scientificOutcome.interpretation: A negative outcome is a valid accepted experiment; phase-aligned demo state with no sustained one-pixel player-position difference does not establish trajectory divergence.
